title: KeyRegistrationRequest
description: POST /aab/v1/signing-keys: register a key (AAB-PLATFORM-09 section 3). The holder's proof of possession, and the registration authority's signed registration.

publicKey.description: An Ed25519 public key, SPKI DER, standard base64.

possessionSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.

registrationSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.
